title: %log - logarithm with optional base
purpose: Take the logarithm of a value, natural by default or in a given base.
notes: With a second argument the result is log(value) / log(base); here log base 2 of 8 is 3.
Omit the base for the natural logarithm.
A value <= 0, or a base <= 0 or equal to 1, yields ~ (null).
